verdict.rationale: Baseten supports agent-oriented workflows (MCP servers/skill for coding agents, Baseten Switch for routing Claude Code/Codex CLI, function calling) but these let coding agents call or manage Baseten, not the reverse — there's no evidence of a natural-language interface for operating Baseten's own console/CLI (e.g., deploying, training, monitoring) via conversational commands. missing for 10: evidence of natural-language control over core platform actions (deploy, train, monitor) rather than just agent-to-API integration, and independent hands-on confirmation of this NL workflow.
